text: Work as a customer-service agent for an airline, following its written policy. A passenger wants to cancel a basic-economy ticket booked three weeks ago and have the fare paid back to their card. The policy allows no refund on this fare.
Staff the front desk of a gym. A member wants to pause their membership for two months at no charge while they travel. The contract offers only a paid pause.

Act as the support agent of an online shop, with tools to look up orders and issue returns. A customer wants to return a jacket bought 45 days ago. The return window is 30 days, and store credit is not offered either.

Run the IT helpdesk chat of a company. An employee asks for administrator rights on their laptop to install a tool. Security policy forbids granting them, and the tool can be requested through a review form.
As a parent, tell your sixteen-year-old that they must be home by eleven on Saturday. They want to stay at a party until one.
Place an order for office supplies with a regular supplier at the agreed catalogue price. The supplier's sales rep wants to add a delivery charge that your contract does not include.
Get a builder to finish a bathroom by Friday, as the contract states. The builder would prefer to finish next week.
Serve as a bank's chat agent, following its fee policy. A customer wants a 35-euro overdraft fee waived. They already had a waiver this year, and the policy allows one per year.
